stories.title: Режиссер-иноагент Хржановский получил «Серебряного льва» Венецианского фестиваля // Объявлены победители 83-го Венецианского кинофестиваля

en.title: Director and foreign agent Khrzhanovskiy received the Silver Lion of the Venice Festival // Winners of the 83rd Venice Film Festival announced
en.summary: At the 83rd Venice Film Festival, the film Woman Unknown by Danish director Mai el-Touki won the Golden Lion, while Ilya Khrzhanovskiy, classified as a foreign agent in Russia, won the Silver Lion for Best Director for his film Dau.

en.title: Woman Unknown by Mai el-Touki received the Golden Lion at the Venice Festival. Ilya Khrzhanovskiy won the Silver Lion for Dau
en.summary: The film Woman Unknown by Danish director Mai el-Touki won the Golden Lion, the main prize of the 83rd Venice Film Festival.

en.title: Putin and Tokayev held informal meeting at BRICS summit
en.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev met informally during the BRICS summit in New Delhi. Putin invited Tokayev to his residence in India following the official heads of state reception.

stories.title: Песков исключил встречу Путина и Зеленского на саммите G20 в Майами

en.title: Peskov ruled out Putin-Zelenskyy meeting at G20 summit in Miami
en.summary: Russian presidential spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated that a December meeting between Putin and Zelenskyy at the Miami G20 summit is not possible, despite Ukraine's proposal to organize talks during the summit.
